recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. The current specification satisfies the seed and later profile-inheritance clarifications, so duplicate edits would add maintenance risk without changing implementer understanding.
issue_request: FHIR-3392 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for FHIR-core StructureDefinition. It asked to add an isSummary element to Profile/ElementDefinition content, defaulting to false, with the final resolution to add isSummary to the profile and make the default the same as the base profile.
initial_application: Jira records application in SVN version 2974 on 2014-10-12. The first current git commit for source/datatypes/elementdefinition.xml already contains the ElementDefinition.isSummary row, so the original application predates accessible git history and remains in current source.
additional_context: Later Published FHIR-core issues refined the same behavior: FHIR-9201 clarified that isSummary cannot be overridden in profiles, FHIR-14272 tied isSummary guidance to the ElementDefinition interpretation table, and FHIR-35855 removed obsolete language implying per-profile summary variation. These related reconciliations are already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source/datatypes/elementdefinition.xml defines ElementDefinition.isSummary as a 0..1 boolean with summary-search usage notes and an interpretation link; source/elementdefinition.html says its presence/value must match the base definition in constrained contexts; and source/profiling.html says _summary=true is based on base resource definitions because profiles cannot change isSummary.
